summary: Union County summit: a 1936 cab after a 1916 fire tower; abandoned in 1942 and gone. No source we read describes the site today.

facts.design: Cab constructed on the site in 1936
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1942 and gone; no source we read describes what remains at the site

notes_for_editor: The 1936 cab date rests on the register alone. The 1916 tower report and the 1920s platform in Firelookout.com are earlier and are not reconciled with the cab; the sources do not say whether they stood on the same spot. The record's kind 'tower' is not confirmed for the 1936 cab. The oregonlookouts page has a bare 'Removed' word near its end with no clear context; not used. A web search found no newer source on the site's condition. The panorama has a NARA credit but no image URL was retrieved, so no photos entry.
